identity.description: Task lifecycle patterns: built-in cooperative cancel, plus provider-composed pause/resume (via a bidirectional control stream) and consumer-composed fail-once retry.

inputs.description: Optional run parameters. `ticks` bounds the pipe work loop; `failOnce` makes a request task fail on its first attempt (drives the retry demo).

ticks.title: Ticks
ticks.description: Progress ticks the pipe work loop emits before completing.

failOnce.title: Fail once
failOnce.description: When true on a request task, throw on the first attempt for this idempotency identity so the consumer can demonstrate retry.

outputs.description: JSON summary of the run: ticks emitted, whether it was paused/resumed, and the completion reason.

control.description: Bidirectional control + progress channel. Outbound: { tick } progress events. Inbound: { ctrl: 'pause' | 'resume' } control messages the handler parks/unparks its work loop on.

tick.description: Monotonic progress counter emitted each active tick.

ctrl.description: Control command: pause parks the work loop; resume continues it.
